claim: The IEA reports that 80% hourly matching of data-centre demand with wind, solar, and batteries can already be cost-competitive with U.S. grid retail prices.
comparisonContext: This is stronger than generic annual renewable matching because it is about hourly physical matching, not just buying certificates.
scopeNote: Modeled hybrid wind, solar, and battery portfolios in the IEA analysis; not a claim that every project is already built this way.
